SELECT CASE WHEN q.q3 GLOB '*:[0-9][0-9].[0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN 'timed' ELSE quote(q.q3) END AS stored_value, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS records, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS drivers, MIN(d.dob) AS first_birth, MAX(d.dob) AS last_birth
FROM main.drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN main.qualifying AS q ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.dob >= '1981-01-01' AND d.dob < '1992-01-01'
GROUP BY stored_value

WITH driver_counts AS (
    SELECT d.driverId, COUNT(NULLIF(q.q3, '')) AS q3_times
    FROM main.drivers AS d
    LEFT JOIN main.qualifying AS q ON q.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE d.dob >= '1981-01-01' AND d.dob < '1992-01-01'
    GROUP BY d.driverId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(q3_times), 2) AS average_q3_times_per_driver
FROM driver_counts
LIMIT 1
